content:
2 years later… and somehow, this day still feels like yesterday. 🤍

Going back to my Class 12 farewell in 2024.

Among all the pictures and memories from that day, this one still holds a special place — receiving the “Miss Dependable” award. 🥹

And there’s actually a little story behind it.

Our class teacher had moved to Canada before our farewell, so of course, we missed having her there on our special day. But she made sure that distance didn’t make us feel forgotten.

She personally made sure that the farewell awards were given to the students who truly deserved them. And knowing that she still thought about our class and took the effort to make those little things special honestly meant so much. 🤍

And then came the best part… I got the “Miss Dependable” award! 😁✨

At that time, I was just happy and excited. But looking back after two years, I realise how meaningful it actually was to be remembered as someone people could trust, rely on and count on.

School feels so different when you look back at it from a distance.

The classrooms, silly conversations, friendships, teachers, annual functions, last-minute assignments, laughing over the smallest things… we never realised how quickly all of it would become memories.

And now, two years later, life has changed so much.

But some memories still take you right back to where you were — standing in your school uniform, surrounded by your classmates, wondering what life after school would look like.

Maybe that’s the best thing about memories. They let us visit the moments we didn’t know we would miss. 🤍

Forever grateful for my school, my teachers, my classmates and especially for this little memory from 2024. ✨

comment: Recognition like this often reflects the everyday actions people notice over time. In workplaces too, reliability is rarely one big moment; it is built through consistent small choices.
